breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO expected to set record when it goes public Friday
breaking_news.summary: SpaceX will go public on the NASDAQ Friday, likely to set a record as the most valuable IPO in history. NASDAQ is making a big play for IPOs, with new rules aimed at drawing in companies like SpaceX.

breaking_news.headline: Can smartphones help explain the drop in birth rates?
breaking_news.summary: Are smartphones causing people to have fewer children?  A provocative new working paper explores the persistent drop in birth rates since the iPhone was introduced nearly two decades ago.

breaking_news.headline: Door shuts on some immigrant entrepreneurs as U.S. restricts small-business loans
breaking_news.summary: For decades, immigrants who are legal permanent residents in the U.S. could get loans through the Small Business Administration, a core pillar of small-business lending. Not anymore.

breaking_news.headline: SpaceX IPO makes history as largest ever. Stock gains 19% on first day
breaking_news.summary: The initial public offering from the rocket and AI company raised some $75 billion, making the company one of the biggest in the world — and likely making Elon Musk a trillionaire.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Dept. approves Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery
breaking_news.summary: The decision paves the way for a proposed $111 billion merger uniting two rival studio giants — Paramount, owner of CBS, and the much larger Warner, which includes HBO and CNN.

breaking_news.headline: Paramount-Warner Brothers merger gets Justice Department approval
breaking_news.summary: The Justice Department closed its investigation into the proposed $110 billion merger of Paramount and Warner Brothers Discovery, saying it found no threat to competition or consumers.

breaking_news.headline: Kennedy Center removes Trump's name from the building
breaking_news.summary: Workers finished removing President Trump's name from the facade of the Kennedy Center early Saturday, hours after a court-ordered Friday deadline to remove references to Trump from the building.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices drop to cheapest level since early days of Middle East conflict
breaking_news.summary: Oil prices had already fallen quite dramatically on Thursday and Friday, in anticipation of an imminent deal. President Trump has posted online that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen after the deal is signed on Friday.

breaking_news.headline: US musician Oliver Tree dies in helicopter collision in Brazil
breaking_news.summary: The singer-songwriter is among six people presumed dead in an air crash over Rio de Janeiro on Sunday.

breaking_news.headline: Russian strikes kill 11 and set historic cathedral in Kyiv ablaze
breaking_news.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack in the Russian city of Tula, south of Moscow, killed three people.

breaking_news.headline: 'Spider-Man of Yemen' dies falling into volcanic crater
breaking_news.summary: Al-Qaqa Ibn Antar had been attempting to climb its walls without safety equipment when he fell in, local authorities say.

breaking_news.headline: MSF staff abused Sudanese refugees in sex-for-food scandal
breaking_news.summary: Some victims said they chose not to speak out because they feared staff would cut off access to aid.

breaking_news.headline: South African jazz legend Abdullah Ibrahim dies at 91
breaking_news.summary: Ibrahim helped define a genre of South African jazz music in a career that spanned eight decades.

breaking_news.headline: Brazil woman dies after rope-jumping instructors fail to attach cord
breaking_news.summary: Three men have been arrested after instructors failed to attach a rope to her before helping her jump from a bridge.

breaking_news.headline: Norwegian crown princess's son found guilty of two counts of rape
breaking_news.summary: Marius Borg Høiby, the 29-year-old son of Norway's Crown Princess Mette Marit, has been sentenced to four years in jail.

breaking_news.headline: Bowen: Iran deal ends Trump's war that revealed limit of US dominance
breaking_news.summary: The deal to end fighting and re-open the Strait of Hormuz leaves the sides where they were 24 hours before the war - only with thousands now dead.

breaking_news.headline: Millions of people can get discounts on their bills - here's how
breaking_news.summary: Lower social tariffs allow many people on benefits to get cheaper deals for water, broadband and phone.

breaking_news.headline: Is the convertible heading into the sunset?
breaking_news.summary: UK drivers have taken a shine to the SUV but could the fate of the convertible be reversed?

breaking_news.headline: Why I sold my business to my staff
breaking_news.summary: As more US company owners reach retirement age many are selling up to their employees.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic to meet White House over AI tool suspension
breaking_news.summary: The sudden meeting was called after Anthropic had to block users from just-released AI models.
